verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an agent and workflow framework, for example batch or parallel processing across many items. The evidence covers only workflows with typed steps, retries and branches, plus event-triggered runs. None of it documents a bulk, batch or for-each capability that acts on many items at once, and those workflow primitives are building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
